title: Organizer creates an Event
description: Step through creating a paid Event (same Pre-registration flow as a tournament): name, Multi Round Robin, date, ratings, capacity, Paid event, price, admission window, then create. Invitation emails to rating-qualified players are covered lightly — a dedicated scenario can expand that later.

steps.title: Organizer on Players
steps.body: An Event is a pre-registration tournament with a fee and event check-in. Creation uses the same + Tournament Pre-registration path as a normal prereg tournament.

steps.title: Open + Tournament
steps.body: Start the type modal, then turn on Pre-registration mode so Event fields appear.

steps.title: Enable Pre-registration
steps.body: Same entry point as a pre-registration tournament: check Pre-registration mode. The primary button becomes Create Pre-registration.

steps.title: Name the Event (required)
steps.body: Type an Event name now. For an Event, a name is required — default auto-generation will not work once Paid event is on.

steps.title: Choose Multi Round Robin
steps.body: Select Multi Round Robin for this walkthrough. Events work with every format; MRR keeps the example simple.

steps.title: Tournament date (required)
steps.body: Tournament Date starts empty and is required. Leave Registration Deadline alone for now — it will fill automatically when you set the date.

steps.title: Registration deadline auto-fills
steps.body: After you set Tournament Date, Registration Deadline defaults to a fixed offset before that time (club Pre-registration setting, often 30 minutes). Do not change it unless you need a custom cutoff.
steps.resultNote: Deadline formed from the tournament date; left unchanged.

steps.title: Rating bounds
steps.body: Set Minimum and Maximum Rating so only players in that band can register. Invitation emails go only to rating-qualified members who allow tournament notifications.

steps.title: Max participants
steps.body: Set Max Participants to cap the field. When that many players hold a seat, further registration stops and invited players are notified that the event is full.

steps.title: Mark Paid event
steps.body: Check Paid event. That turns this pre-registration into an Event: fee, event check-in, and a required Event Name (auto-generation will not work).

steps.title: Min participants
steps.body: Set Min Participants (shown for Events). If you Finalize with fewer registered players than this minimum, the system warns that the field is below the Event minimum.

steps.title: Event price
steps.body: Adjust Event Price from the club default. Players see Register & pay with this amount.

steps.title: Admission window
steps.body: Admissions starts controls how far before start players can check in for the Event (without a separate club day charge in that window). Change the hours as needed.

steps.title: Create Pre-registration
steps.body: Submit Create Pre-registration. The Event is listed under Preregistration, and invitation emails go to rating-qualified players who have tournament notifications on. (A future showcase can cover those emails in detail.)

steps.title: Event created
steps.body: The named Event is under Preregistration with its fee and check-in window. Players can register; organizers Finalize later when the field is ready.
steps.resultNote: Paid Event created; invitations sent to qualified members.
